statusValues.IMPLEMENTED: Screen wired to a real domain service or persistence
statusValues.MOCK: Screen rendered but data is hardcoded/mock; mutations audit-only or labelled demo seed
statusValues.MISSING: Screen ID specified in UIUX-001 R1.1 but no implementation surface exists
statusValues.DEFERRED: Formally deferred under DEC-RL1-SCOPE-001; informational/absent by decision
statusValues.ALIAS: Screen shares a template with another ID; alias recorded
